import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from brackets.core import is_balanced

def test():
    # Empty string
    assert is_balanced('') == True, "empty"
    # Single pairs
    assert is_balanced('()') == True
    assert is_balanced('[]') == True
    assert is_balanced('{}') == True
    # Multiple adjacent
    assert is_balanced('()[]{}') == True
    # Nested mixed
    assert is_balanced('([{}])') == True
    # With other characters
    assert is_balanced('(a[b]{c})') == True
    assert is_balanced('f(x[0], y[1])') == True
    # Unbalanced opening
    assert is_balanced('(') == False
    assert is_balanced('[') == False
    assert is_balanced('{') == False
    # Unbalanced closing
    assert is_balanced(')') == False
    assert is_balanced(']') == False
    assert is_balanced('}') == False
    # Mismatched
    assert is_balanced('([)]') == False
    assert is_balanced('(]') == False
    assert is_balanced('{[}') == False
    # Extra closing
    assert is_balanced('())') == False
    assert is_balanced('[]]') == False
    assert is_balanced('}{}') == False
    # Non-bracket ignored
    assert is_balanced('abc') == True
    assert is_balanced('a(b)c[d]e{f}g') == True
    # Ensure bool return
    assert isinstance(is_balanced(''), bool)
    assert isinstance(is_balanced('()'), bool)
    # TypeError
    try:
        is_balanced(123)
        assert False, "Expected TypeError for int"
    except TypeError:
        pass
    try:
        is_balanced([])
        assert False, "Expected TypeError for list"
    except TypeError:
        pass
    try:
        is_balanced(None)
        assert False, "Expected TypeError for None"
    except TypeError:
        pass
    print('All tests passed')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test()
